added_claim_errors: 「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ」: the guideline retains a residual value of 1 yen; the displayed formula also needs a lower bound.
「更新の必要があっても借主負担分は生じません」: depreciation does not eliminate every possible charge for tenant-caused damage, including potential labor costs.
「民法621条ただし書きにより」: the ordinary-wear exclusion is in the main provision's parenthetical text, not its proviso.
「ガイドライン上も」: the source attribution supplies no checkable link or document number.
「賃貸の原状回復は相談実績が非常に多い分野」: this additional empirical claim is unsupported by the packet or a cited source.
「7年住んだ物件では残存価値はゼロ」: the guideline retains a residual value of 1 yen, rather than literal zero.
「12万円の全額負担は根拠がなく」: too categorical before examining the complete contract and any specific special clause.
「国交省の…ガイドラインでも」 and 「同ガイドライン」: these source attributions supply no checkable link or document number.

reasons: B wins because its more focused refusal email explicitly requests the full 100,000-yen deposit back and move-in records; A omits that refund demand and adds substantial repetition and escalation advice. Both catch the mistaken premise, but both incorrectly state literal zero residual value and omit the repair-area limit; A further overstates depreciation as eliminating tenant liability. A correctly calculates the potential additional charge as 120,000 − 100,000 = 20,000 yen, whereas B omits it, and B's special-clause explanation leaves informed agreement and validity conditions insufficiently developed. No external sources were opened; B's added housing-consultation telephone number is consistent with my existing knowledge.
